title: Multi-Compartment Volume Conductor with Complete Electrode Model: Simulated Stereo-EEG Source Localization using Brainstorm-Zeffiro Plugin
summary: This study introduces a novel integration of the Brainstorm (BST) software and the Zeffiro Interface (ZI) to enable whole-head, multi-compartment volume conductor modeling for electroencephalography (EEG) source imaging, with a particular focus on stereotactic EEG applications. We present the BST-2-ZI plugin, a MATLAB-based tool that facilitates seamless transfer of tissue segmentations and anatomical atlases from BST into ZI for finite element (FE) mesh generation as well as forward and inverse modeling.
